findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "risk" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: token_risk, counterparty_check, evm_token_security, erc20_info, evm_tx, solana_network, address_check, vuln_check · Private data: token_risk, launch_scan, counterparty_check, price, wallet_holdings, tx_explain, evm_token_security, evm_address, erc20_info, evm_tx, ens_resolve, address_check, vuln_check · Public sink: ens_resolve, address_check · Destructive: evm_token_security, address_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: token_risk, counterparty_check, evm_token_security, erc20_info, evm_tx, solana_network, address_check, vuln_check · Private data: token_risk, launch_scan, counterparty_check, price, wallet_holdings, tx_explain, evm_token_security, evm_address, erc20_info, evm_tx, ens_resolve, address_check, vuln_check · Public sink: ens_resolve, address_check · Destructive: evm_token_security, address_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
